# About

This is the report for the default federated aggregation analysis pipeline. Currently, it only provides the design file with the filepaths updated to the results folder of this job run.

# Design File updated

```{r res_table}
# Read the table in as a dataframe
data <- read.table(params$res_table, header = TRUE, sep = ",", check.names = FALSE)
# Generate reactable with data from reactable_funcs.R
generateReactable(data, name="new_design_file.csv")
```
